title: Open Workout Schema v0: workout
description: One workout: exercise entries with their sets, plus where the record came from. Draft; may change until v1.

id.description: Assigned by the server that stores the workout.

updated_at.description: When the stored record last changed, by the server's clock: the workout, an entry, a set or the program label. For mirroring; absent from a document that was never stored.

merged_sources.description: Other records of the same session, merged into this one: the same run from two apps, say. This workout is the fullest of them.

program.description: The program day this workout was part of: a label, which changes nothing else here. listed false means the program was withdrawn, and says nothing more.

estimates.description: JSON pointers (RFC 6901) to values that were inferred or assumed rather than given.

source.description: Provenance: where the record came from.

client.description: The client or app, e.g. claude, strong, hevy.

external_id.description: The workout's ID in the app it was imported from.

id.description: Assigned by the server; used to edit the entry.

text.description: What the user called the exercise.

exercise.description: The exercise an entry was matched to. catalogue and custom are confirmed; close and unmatched need confirmation and never count toward records.

id.description: Open Exercise Catalogue ID (oec:<slug>) or a custom exercise ID; null when nothing matched.
Assigned by the server; used to edit the set.

load.description: A weight in the unit the user gave it.
